sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Danger

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Real drowsy defense means two-hour breaks with short naps and rested drivers, while windows, gum, radio, and caffeine only pretend to help [A01].
Why it matters: group drowsy-defense; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F01, sec11-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Adults meet DUI at point-oh-eight, while drivers under twenty-one meet illegal consumption from point-oh-two and DUI at point-oh-eight [A01].
Why it matters: group bac-tiers; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
One drink already bends vision and judgment sevenfold, while equal pours of beer, liquor, and wine each bend it the same [A01].
Why it matters: group drink-effects; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F04, sec11-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A01
Only time sobers a drinker past coffee and cold showers, matching how only real rest beats drowsiness past caffeine [A01].
Why it matters: group sobering-myths; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F05, sec11-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A01
Holding any wireless device breaks the law outside emergencies and parked stops, while hands-free navigation without typing stays legal [A01].
Why it matters: group phone-law; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A01
Distraction eats recognition seconds behind seventeen percent of crashes, while eyes-up, preset, phone-down habits buy them back [A01].
Why it matters: group distraction-cause-effect; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F08, sec11-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A01
Yawns, nods, and rumble strips warn of drowsiness already arrived, while sleep banking and meal care stop it before the trip [A01].
Why it matters: group drowsy-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F10, sec11-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A02
A booked sober ride dodges the whole question, while one drink stacked on pills can multiply into several [A02].
Why it matters: group sober-planning; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A02
Street drugs impair, and so do headache, cold, and allergy remedies plus legal marijuana behind the wheel [A02].
Why it matters: group drug-scope; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A02
Drivable and unhurt means clear the road at once, while hurt occupants mean shield, aid, and summon without moving them [A02].
Why it matters: group crash-move; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A02
Manned crashes trade papers and call insurers on the spot, while empty-car strikes leave name-phone-time notes plus a twenty-four-hour police report [A02].
Why it matters: group crash-paperwork; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F14, sec11-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A02
Injury, death, or three-thousand-dollar damage routes to DMV records, while any large-animal strike routes to law enforcement [A02].
Why it matters: group crash-reports; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F14, sec11-F16 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A02
Near deer want slowing, horns, and group wariness, while certain contact wants straight-line braking with no swerve [A02].
Why it matters: group deer-response; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F16 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
